name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner asks you to find Teronis in Raene's Cleansing. He set out toward Lake Falathim to recover a magic gemstone and find a way to halt the furbolgs' growing aggression.

sections.title: A Friend's Concern
sections.body: Raene Wolfrunner serves with the Sentinels in Astranaar, defending Ashenvale from mounting threats. Teronis was among her closest companions. He set out to find a strong defense against the furbolg tribes as they grew more violent. Days passed without his return, and Raene feared the worst while duty kept her at her post.

sections.title: The Search for the Rod
sections.body: Teronis followed rumors of a powerful rod forged by a wicked wizard who had died. He believed its magic could calm the furbolg fury. To restore the rod, he needed an enchanted gem hidden in an elven shrine at Lake Falathim, near the mountains to the west. Yet aggressive murloc tribes had recently taken the lake's once-tranquil waters.

sections.title: Tragedy at Lake Falathim
sections.body: Teronis's trail leads to the island in Lake Falathim, where a grim sight waits. Teronis never left the waters alive. His body lies slain upon the shrine, marked by deep slashes from murloc weapons and claws. There his search came to an untimely end.

faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner is a night elf allied with the Sentinels of Ashenvale and stationed in Astranaar. She oversees the forest's defenses against encroaching enemies.
Teronis was a close friend of Raene Wolfrunner who sought ancient magic to save the forest. Believing an enchanted rod could calm the corrupted furbolgs, he traveled alone to find its components.
Teronis went missing at Lake Falathim, at the foot of Ashenvale's western mountains. The lake had fallen to hostile murlocs.

faq.q: Why was Teronis looking for a gem?
faq.answer: The gem was needed to restore a magic rod forged by a deceased evil wizard. Teronis hoped to use the rod's power to stem the enraged furbolgs' attacks.
Raene has not heard from Teronis since he went to Lake Falathim.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs attacking Ashenvale?
faq.answer: After the Third War, demonic corruption and madness overcame Ashenvale's furbolgs. Once peaceful, the tribes turned violently against their old allies.

angles.text: Teronis's disappearance is another bitter blow to the night elves, already stretched thin as they heal Ashenvale and protect its shrines from corruption.
Alliance recruits arriving in Astranaar quickly learn that hostile wild beasts, furbolgs, and invasive murlocs threaten Ashenvale's sacred groves.
